items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Approve no new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, or unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; the aggregate amount is not site-attributable, so site economics are unsupported. AI usage reports $886.12 across 4,865 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align; infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, experiment-cost, approved-budget, and learning-outcome records are missing, and monthly spending limits are blank. Continue only existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation using recorded telemetry. Minimum measurement: attributable revenue by site/content and tracking ID for matching periods; reconciled AI-cost ledger; infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing/experiment costs; approved budget limits; and an explicit cost-to-learn threshold. Treat impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, orders, shipped items, rankings, and AI usage as non-financial vanity or activity metrics unless tied to attributable contribution.

The candidate plan is financially acceptable only as containment. Retain repair-or-close, deterministic validation, rollback, deduplication, measurement reconciliation, and bounded legal/security evidence work already in progress. Defer all new proposals, queue work, experiments, telemetry, deployments, spending, commitments, and monetization changes while 47 failure follow-ups remain open, 28 improvements await measurement, the actionable candidate list is empty, and only 2 outcomes are proven in the 30-day scorecard dated 2026-09-27. Do not forecast revenue or claim causal lift from the current evidence.
